# __PROJECT_NAME__

> An Avalanche dapp scaffolded with AvaKit (https://github.com/mericcintosun/AvaKit). Next.js + @avakit/react + shadcn/ui. Social-login onboarding, deploy-ready, black & white with dark/light from day one.

## Project map

- [app/providers.tsx](app/providers.tsx): AvaKitProvider (chains + wallet adapters) and theme provider. The chain is `__CHAIN_CONST__` (`fuji` = Fuji testnet, `cChain` = C-Chain mainnet) and the wallet setup follows it: on a testnet a temporary burner wallet plus social login on a bundled demo key; on mainnet no burner, and social login only with your own Sapphire Mainnet `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID`.
- [app/layout.tsx](app/layout.tsx): root layout and fonts.
- [app/page.tsx](app/page.tsx): renders the demo.
- [components/demo.tsx](components/demo.tsx): connect wallet, read balance, send a transaction.
- [components/funding.tsx](components/funding.tsx): `useFunding()` + `<FundingNotice />` — polls the balance while the wallet is empty, reports the faucet (`useFaucet()`), and disables transaction buttons only while the balance is really zero.
- [app/globals.css](app/globals.css): shadcn tokens (black & white) + dark/light.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): agent guide with the AvaKit API and project rules.

## Test AVAX

On Fuji, `app/providers.tsx` passes `faucetUrl` to `<AvaKitProvider>`: the temporary wallet is funded automatically when it connects, any other empty wallet through `useFaucet().fund()` ("Get test AVAX"). Default: AvaKit's shared Fuji faucet — rate-limited (one small drip per address per day, plus an hourly cap per IP address), paid for by the AvaKit maintainer, for first runs only. `NEXT_PUBLIC_AVAKIT_FAUCET_URL` = your own faucet's `/fund` URL (Worker in `services/faucet` of the AvaKit repository), or `off`. Never passed off Fuji. Fallback when it refuses: the official faucet (needs a free Builder Hub sign-in). Do not call `fund()` on mount (the provider already asks for the temporary wallet; a second request is refused), and treat `status: "success"` as "sent", not "arrived": wait for a non-zero balance.

## Key APIs (@avakit/react)

- `<AvaKitProvider chains={[...]} adapters={[...]} faucetUrl={...}>` (`faucetUrl` is optional and Fuji-only here)
- `<ConnectAvalanche />` — drop-in wallet button
- `useAvaAccount()`, `useAvaChain()`, `useBalance()`, `useContract()`, `useAvaDeploy()`, `useFaucet()`, `useAvaKit()`

## Key APIs (@avakit/core)

- `fuji`, `cChain`, `defineChain` from `@avakit/core/chains`; `isMainnet(chain)`
- `injectedAdapter()`, `burnerAdapter({ chain })` (testnet-only), `web3authAdapter({ clientId, chains, network })` (from `@avakit/core/web3auth`; `network` is `"sapphire_devnet"` or `"sapphire_mainnet"`)
- `getPublicClient`, `getWalletClient`, `ensureChain`, `deployContract`, `getBalance`, `readContract`

## External docs

- Avalanche Builder Hub: https://build.avax.network/llms.txt
- Web3Auth dashboard (free client ID): https://dashboard.web3auth.io
- Official Fuji faucet (needs a free Builder Hub sign-in; the app's temporary wallet is funded without one, see "Test AVAX"): https://build.avax.network/console/primary-network/faucet
- Run your own faucet: https://github.com/mericcintosun/AvaKit/tree/main/services/faucet
